shiftLock.slot: ALL 1st through 3rd Gen (1999-2014) use COLUMN SHIFT — shift lock on STEERING COLUMN. Key to ON + brake releases interlock normally. Dead battery (below 9V): restore power via jump pack first. NOTE: 2003-2006 and some 2007+ also had optional console shift — console variant has a small cap at the side of the console shifter base.
steps: Turn ignition key to ON (do not start). This energizes the shift interlock.
COLUMN SHIFT (standard): locate the shift lock release slot on the STEERING COLUMN — lower face of the column below the shift lever.
Insert a thin flathead into the slot and press firmly inward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the column lever from Park to Neutral.
DEAD BATTERY: interlock requires ~9V minimum. Connect jump pack — battery under hood.
CONSOLE SHIFT (some trims): small cap at the side of the console shifter base — pry off, insert key, press down while pressing brake.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack.
Column shift: key to ON, slot on column, press brake, move to N.
Console shift (some trims): side cap on console shifter base.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before towing. Jump battery first if needed.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
AIR SUSPENSION: May lower/raise unexpectedly. Verify ride height is stable before loading on flatbed. Some models have a 'jack mode' or 'transport mode' — check with owner if possible.
HEAVY VEHICLE: Use properly rated wheel blocks, straps, and chains. Verify your equipment weight rating before attempting to load or lift.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

battery.warning: Heavy vehicle. Verify TC is in 2WD before lifting.

alerts.warning: 4WD: transfer case MUST be in 2H before towing.
alerts.notes: 4WD: transfer case to 2H before towing on road.

issues.title: Transfer Case Must Be in 2WD — Not Just Neutral
issues.detail: Operators sometimes shift the transfer case to Neutral thinking that's safe to tow. The driveshaft is still connected in TC Neutral on these models. Transfer case MUST be in 2WD (2H) for wheel-lift towing, not just neutral.

issues.title: Heavy Vehicle — Equipment Ratings
issues.detail: Escalade curb weight ranges 5,600–6,200 lbs depending on year and trim. Verify your wheel-lift and strapping equipment is rated appropriately before attempting to lift.

shiftLock.slot: 4th Gen (2015-2020): COLUMN SHIFT — same as Silverado/Suburban of same era. Shift lock slot on the STEERING COLUMN. Key to ON + brake releases interlock. Dead battery: restore power via jump pack. 5th Gen (2021-2023): PUSH-BUTTON EPS — NO CABIN OVERRIDE. Owner's manual states: cannot shift to neutral with dead battery. Restore 12V power first. FLATBED with wheel dollies if power cannot be restored. 2024+ (facelift): COLUMN SHIFT again — same as 4th gen procedure.
steps: IDENTIFY GENERATION FIRST.
4TH GEN (2015-2020) — COLUMN SHIFT:
Turn ignition key to ON. Locate shift lock slot on lower face of STEERING COLUMN.
Insert thin flathead into slot, press firmly. Press brake. Move column lever to N.
4TH GEN DEAD BATTERY: restore power via jump pack — battery under hood.
5TH GEN (2021-2023) — EPS PUSH-BUTTON (NO CABIN OVERRIDE):
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — connect jump pack to underhood battery.
Once powered, press brake and use push-button row (left of infotainment screen) to select N.
5TH GEN WITHOUT POWER: owner's manual explicit — cannot shift or release EPB with dead battery.
FLATBED with wheel dollies only if power cannot be restored.
2024+ REFRESH: COLUMN SHIFT returned — use same procedure as 4th gen above.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
4th gen: key to ON, column slot, press brake, move to N.
5th gen: restore power, then push-button N selector.
5th gen no power: FLATBED ONLY with wheel dollies.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before towing. Jump battery first if needed.

issues.title: Electronic Selector Requires Power
issues.detail: 4th and 5th gen Escalade uses a fully electronic gear selector. With a dead battery, the shift lock slot must be used. The slot is concealed under a trim panel — locate it before the job if possible.

issues.title: Escalade IQ EV (2025+) — Flatbed Only
issues.detail: The 2025 Escalade IQ is a full EV. FLATBED ONLY. No transfer case. 12V auxiliary battery only for electronics. Never touch the HV propulsion battery.

issues.title: 5th Gen (2021-2023) — No Cabin Neutral Override, EPB Auto-Engages
issues.detail: The 5th-gen Escalade has push-button EPS and a hydraulic park pawl. Owner's manual states: with dead 12V battery, electric parking brake cannot be released and vehicle cannot be shifted to Neutral. Flatbed with tire skates/dollies required. The EPB will also auto-engage if manual park release is used while powered. The 4th gen (2015-2020) used a traditional column shift and does NOT have this issue.

shiftLock.slot: Electronic Precision Shift (EPS) console selector. MANUAL PARK RELEASE: behind small cover in driver's kick panel, just to the RIGHT of the gas pedal. Pull the manual release handle to disengage the park lock. Owner's manual: Driving and Operating → Manual Park Release. SERVICE MODE (with partial power): hold Start button (no brake) ~5 sec until lights/chimes, then press brake and move selector to N. RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST whenever possible.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly preferred. Battery under hood.
Once powered: press Start without brake to enter accessory/service mode, press brake, press EPS selector button and move lever to N.
WITHOUT POWER — MANUAL PARK RELEASE (2016-2020 models):
Locate the small cover in the driver's kick panel, just to the RIGHT of the gas pedal.
Open the cover to access the manual park release handle.
Pull the handle firmly upward/outward to release the park lock.
Vehicle will roll — ensure parking brake is chocked first.
SERVICE MODE (with partial power, older 8-speed models only):
Hold Start button (no brake) for ~5 seconds until all electronics activate.
Release Start, then press brake, press EPS side button, move lever to N.
NOTE: Service mode may show 'conditions not met' on newer 9-speed models — use manual release.
2021+ models: some may not have kick-panel lever — restore power or flatbed.
Apply parking brake.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack.
Restore power, then shift to N via EPS selector.
No power: kick-panel manual park release (see shift steps).
AWD: FLATBED PREFERRED.

notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

shiftLock.slot: Small plastic cap on the TOP LEFT of the shifter trim cover, on the console beside the selector. Pry off cap, insert flathead into the hole, press DOWN to release shift lock. FWD — lift from front.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the small plastic cap on the TOP LEFT of the shifter trim cover on the console.
Pry off the cap with the ignition key or a small flathead.
Insert a flathead screwdriver into the hole and press firmly DOWNWARD.
While holding the release, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air.
